product.title: Arches National Park Hike Challenge: Tackle Devils Garden 7m Loop

description.text: The Primitive Loop of Devil's Garden is billed as a phenomenal ~7-mile mildly strenuous hike inside Arches National Park with a professional guide. The experience illuminates the geologic events that formed the park's fins and arches, desert ecology/botany, and cultural heritage. Stops include Devils Garden, Landscape Arch, Devils Garden Primitive Loop. This is a guided hiking challenge focused on Devils Garden—not a jeep tour despite legacy URL slug. Ideal for visitors basing in Moab who want a guided Arches National Park experience without coordinating timed entry, trailheads, or backcountry logistics on their own.
